script.title: FIRST DAY PLANS
script.story_hook: A new family hopes to start school by Thursday.
script.intro_zh: 剛搬來的家庭，希望週四就能開學。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a dad registers his son for school. Listen for office questions and answers.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一位爸爸幫兒子登記上學。留意櫃檯的問句與回答。
script.outro: One form, one fax, one new student. Thursday, here they come!
script.outro_zh: 一張表、一份傳真、一位新生。週四，他們來啦！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each registration phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀登記常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a father in his mid-thirties with short curly dark brown hair and a clean-shaven round face, wearing a forest green hoodie, faded blue jeans and gray running shoes, broad shoulders, looking hopeful
script.char_b_description: a senior woman in her early sixties with a silver bob haircut and small pearl earrings, wearing a lavender blouse under a gray cardigan, a black skirt and low heels, kind eyes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! I'm here to enroll my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪm hɪɹ tə ɪnˈɹoʊl maɪ sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 早安！我來幫兒子登記上學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! Welcome. Do you have your paperwork?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈwɛlkəm du ju hæv jʊɹ ˈpeɪpɚwɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！歡迎。文件都帶來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some of it, I hope. Where do I start?
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm əv ɪt aɪ ˈhoʊp wɛɹ du aɪ ˈstɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 希望帶夠了。我該從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, this blue form. Name and birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst ðɪs blu fɔɹm neɪm ænd ˈbɜɹθdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先填這張藍色表。姓名和出生年月日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Next, our address... like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn nɛkst ˈaʊɚ əˈdɹɛs laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。接著是住址…這樣對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — zip code, too. Then I'll copy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst zɪp koʊd tu ðɛn aɪl ˈkɑpi ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了—郵遞區號也請補上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Um, why do you need my address?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm waɪ du ju nid maɪ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃，為什麼需要住址？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Schools serve local families. It's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /skulz sɜɹv ˈloʊkəl ˈfæməliz ɪts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 學校按學區收附近家庭。這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Do I need proof, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪks ˈsɛns du aɪ ˈnid ˈpɹuf ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。可是要證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — a utility bill works. Do you have one?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə juˈtɪləti bɪl wɜɹks du ju hæv wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 要。一張水電費帳單就行。你有帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My electric bill, right here in the folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɪˈlɛktɹɪk bɪl ɹaɪt hɪɹ ɪn ðə ˈfoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 電力帳單就在資料夾裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Next, his school records from Texas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt nɛkst hɪz skul ˈɹɛkɚdz fɹʌm ˈtɛksəs/
dialogue.zh: 完美。接著是他在德州的教育資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a report card. Is that enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ɹɪˈpɔɹt kɑɹd ɪz ðæt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我有一張成績單。這樣夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a start. Did he finish the last unit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə stɑɹt dɪd hi ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə læst ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有就好。他最後一個單元學完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... honestly, we moved in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑnəstli wi mud ɪn mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 呃…說實話，我們三月就搬家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So March is where he stopped?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɑɹtʃ ɪz wɛɹ hi ˈstɑpt/
dialogue.zh: 所以他的學習停在三月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. Will that cause trouble?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪl ðæt kɔz ˈtɹʌbl̩/
dialogue.zh: 是。這會不會有麻煩？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all. We'll place him carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑɾ æt ɔl wil pleɪs hɪm ˈkɛɹfəli/
dialogue.zh: 完全不會。我們會用心幫他分班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Oh, here's his vaccine record.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju oʊ hɪɹz hɪz vækˈsin ˈɹɛkɚd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。噢，這是他的預防接種紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Let's see... one shot is missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl̩ lɛts si wʌn ʃɑt ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 很好。讓我看看…缺一劑疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing? He got everything, I think!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ hi ɡɑɾ ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 缺？我記得他都打全了呀！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This line says two shots. Here's only one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs laɪn sɛz tu ʃɑts hɪɹz ˈonli wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這一列寫著要打兩劑。這裡只有一劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh-oh. The clinic gave it. I'm sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ˈoʊ ðə ˈklɪnɪk ɡeɪv ɪt aɪm ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 糟了。是診所幫他打的，我很確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stress. We call them, they fax it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈstɹɛs wi ˈkɔl ðɛm ðeɪ ˈfæks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 別緊張。我們打電話，請診所傳真過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They fax? Today? Oh, that would help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ fæks təˈdeɪ oʊ ðæt wʊd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 他們會傳真？今天嗎？噢，那幫大忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me the clinic's name and number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ðə ˈklɪnɪks neɪm ænd ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請告訴我診所的名字和電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Riverside Clinic. The number's on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪvɚsaɪd ˈklɪnɪk ðə ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn ðə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 河濱診所。號碼就在這張卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm calling now... one moment... hello?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈkɔlɪŋ naʊ wʌn ˈmoʊmənt həˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就打…稍等…喂，你好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is so convenient. I hate phone tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz soʊ kənˈvinjənt aɪ heɪt foʊn tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣太方便了。我最討厭打電話總是找不到人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! It happens. She's checking the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt ˈhæpənz ʃiz ˈtʃɛkɪŋ ðə faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 哈！常有的事。她在翻檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... um, will my son repeat math?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm wɪl maɪ sʌn ɹɪˈpit mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 好…呃，我兒子會重上數學嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good question. The new unit starts fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkwɛsʧən ðə nu ˈjunɪt stɑɹts fɹɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 問得好。新單元會從頭教。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! His report says he's quiet, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt hɪz ɹɪˈpɔɹt sɛz hiz ˈkwaɪət tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！報告還寫他個性很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet is fine. He'll warm up fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪz faɪn hil wɔɹm ʌp fæst/
dialogue.zh: 安靜沒關係。他很快就會放開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sound sure. How do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈsaʊnd ˈʃʊɹ haʊ du ju ˈnoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你說得好有把握。怎麼會知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years of first days. Trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪɹz ʌv fɜɹst deɪz tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 我看了二十年第一天上學的孩子。相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay! Oh, his old teacher wrote you a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ oʊ hɪz oʊld ˈtitʃɚ ɹoʊt ju ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好！噢，他以前的老師寫了一封信給你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A note? I'll read it at lunch, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈnoʊt aɪl ˈɹid ɪt æt ˈlʌntʃ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 信？我午餐時一定看，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She really cared about him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈɹɪli kɛɹd əˈbaʊt hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 她真的很關心我兒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can tell. Oh — the fax came through!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈtɛl oʊ ðə ˈfæks ˈkeɪm ˈθɹu/
dialogue.zh: 看得出來。噢—傳真過來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? Wow, that was quick!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɛdi waʊ ðæt wʌz kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？哇，效率真高！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two shots confirmed. He's all caught up.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃɑts kənˈfɜɹmd hiz ɔl kɔt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 兩劑都確認了。他的接種完全補齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a relief. So, is he enrolled?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə ɹɪˈlif soʊ ɪz hi ɪnˈɹoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 太讓人鬆口氣了。所以，他登記好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — one photo for his ID card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ fɚ hɪz aɪdi kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 還差一張學生證照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A photo? He's... pretty messy this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊtoʊ hiz ˈpɹɾi ˈmɛsi ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 照片？他這星期…頭髮亂亂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one right here, with your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪk wʌn ˈraɪt hɪɹ wɪθ jʊɹ ˈfoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡用手機拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like... now? Say cheese, Samuel!
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk naʊ seɪ tʃiz ˈsæmjəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在嗎？茄子，Samuel！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There! Printing it... look, a student ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ˈpɹɪntɪŋ ɪt lʊk ə ˈstudənt aɪdi/
dialogue.zh: 好了！正在列印…看，學生證出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow. He'll show that to the bus driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ hil ˈʃoʊ ðæt tə ðə ˈbʌs ˈdɹaɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哇。他要把這個給公車司機看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the teacher, every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ðə ˈtitʃɚ ˈɛvɹi ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，每天早上還要給老師看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bus? Oh — does the yellow one stop nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌs oʊ dʌz ðə ˈjɛloʊ wʌn stɑp ˌnɪɹˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 公車？噢—黃色校車會在附近停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oak and Fifth, seven-fifteen. About a block.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊk ænd fɪfθ ˈsɛvən ˈfɪftin əˈbaʊt ə blɑk/
dialogue.zh: 橡樹街和五街口，七點十五分。大約一個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One block! We used to walk twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blɑk wi ˈjust tə wɑk ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 就一個街口！我們以前要走二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small wins. Here's his schedule and map.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɪnz hɪɹz hɪz ˈskɛdʒul ænd mæp/
dialogue.zh: 好事一樁。這是他的課表和地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch money... can I add it online?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌntʃ ˈmʌni kæn aɪ æd ɪt ˌɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 午餐費…我可以在線上儲值嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it rolls over each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪt ɹoʊlz ˈoʊvɚ itʃ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，用不完會留到下個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. When does the first day start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt wɛn dʌz ðə fɜɹst deɪ stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。開學日哪天開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday, eight sharp. Regular clothes, no uniform.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzdeɪ eɪt ʃɑɹp ˈɹɛɡjəlɛɹ kloʊz noʊ ˈjuniˌfɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 週四，八點整。一般穿著就好，沒有制服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday. Thank you so much, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzdeɪ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ mæm/
dialogue.zh: 週四。真的太感謝您了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome! Say hi to Samuel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈwɛlkəm seɪ haɪ tə ˈsæmjəl/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！替我向 Samuel 問好。

script.youtube_description:
60句學校行政聽力練習：剛搬來小鎮，孩子週四就要開學，登記要帶什麼文件？

這一集跟著一位爸爸走進學校登記處，學會填表、證明學區住址、補預防接種紀錄、打電話請診所傳真，還有分班、公車、午餐費和學生證拍照的全部說法。

你會聽到：
- 登記填表與住址證明的問答
- 疫苗紀錄缺一劑時的補件流程
- 電話、傳真等辦公場景實用詞
- 開學日、公車時間與午餐費儲存

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of school-office listening practice: a family just moved to town, and Thursday is the first day of school. At the registrar's desk, a dad learns what paperwork counts as proof of address, fixes a missing vaccine shot with one phone call and a fax, and even snaps a student ID photo on the spot.

You will hear how to fill out forms, talk about school records and catch-up plans, and ask about buses and lunch money. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.thumbnail_action: handing over a folder of papers
